name: Novalink Networks Incorporated
notes: Novalink Networks Incorporated is a internet service company based in General Santos City, providing reliable and high-speed fiber-optic connectivity for residential and business customers. Its services include Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH), business internet, dedicated internet access, static public IP services, and customized connectivity solutions. Novalink operates with its own Autonomous System Number (AS154931) and allocated IPv4 and IPv6 resources, supporting a scalable network designed for reliable connectivity and future expansion.
